experiment: BC1 — why black copper is black, and where its electrons go
status: pre-registered before running bc1_run.py; no exploratory run
author_hypothesis: Black copper was expected to make light/electricity because the black colour guides electrons in one direction; with rising temperature that effect should appear.
finding_before_run: The black layer of black copper is CuO, a p-type semiconductor (band gap ~1.2-1.5 eV), not copper metal. The earlier refutation module used the Seebeck coefficient of copper METAL (1.8 uV/K) for 'black copper'. Literature reports CuO Seebeck coefficients of order hundreds of uV/K (value range quoted from memory; to be checked against sources).

A_colour.Cu_metal: Drude free electrons (hbar*omega_p = 8.8 eV, hbar*gamma = 0.09 eV) plus an interband d->s absorption onset at 2.1 eV; normal-incidence Fresnel reflectance
A_colour.CuO: semiconductor absorption alpha(E) = A*sqrt(E-Eg) above Eg = 1.35 eV (A set so alpha(2.5 eV) = 1e5 /cm); background index n = 2.6; nanostructured surface modelled as a graded-index layer (Fresnel reflectance reduced by a factor 20); film 1 um thick

B_electron_tracking.slab: CuO, 1 um thick, 1-D Monte Carlo, 20000 photo-excited carriers per case (SEED = 19)
B_electron_tracking.generation: depth from Beer-Lambert at 2.5 eV; initial direction isotropic (cos-theta uniform), excess energy E - Eg
B_electron_tracking.transport: random walk with mean free path 5 nm, energy relaxation to the band edge in 0.3 ps (excess energy -> heat), recombination lifetime 1 ns

cases.C2_junction: built-in field 1e5 V/m over the slab (a junction, e.g. CuO/ZnO)
cases.C3_gradient: no field; temperature gradient 400 K -> 300 K across the slab, diffusion D proportional to local T

B_electron_tracking.collection: a carrier reaching the front (z=0) or back (z=d) face is collected there; net current = (back - front)/generated

predictions.P1_colour: Cu metal: mean visible reflectance > 0.5 with red (1.8 eV) reflectance > blue (2.8 eV) reflectance; CuO film: mean visible absorptance > 0.9 (black)
predictions.P2_black_alone_no_direction: C1: |net current| / generated < 0.02 — absorbing light (being black) does not by itself send electrons one way
predictions.P3_heat: C1: more than 90% of the absorbed photon energy ends as heat (excess-energy relaxation plus recombination)
predictions.P4_junction_directs: C2: net current / generated > 0.3 toward the field direction
predictions.P5_gradient_directs: C3: net carrier flux is nonzero and flows from hot to cold, and reverses sign when the gradient is reversed
